method: A fresh Node process imported the exact packaged latest-base RootRunPackageReadinessIndex and executed one read-only rebuild against the same memory root used by the Electron backend. The process did not invoke migrations, index writers, mutations, providers, or the running server.

sourceAttribution.startup: server-runtime.ts rebuilds the shared readiness generation before listen
sourceAttribution.agentOrgFirstHistoryRead: agent-org-run-history-catalog-service.ts calls packageCatalog.rebuild() again while initializing
sourceAttribution.teamComparator: team-run-history-catalog-service.ts calls packageCatalog.awaitReady() and reuses the existing/lazily-established generation

resultInterpretation: The first AgentOrg history request can repeat a complete Team+AgentOrg package-readiness scan already completed before the server listened. On this real package population, that duplicate scan alone took 26.657 seconds and blocks ListCollaborationRootHistory, while workspace Team history uses the already-ready catalog path.
dataSafety: Counts and duration only; no paths, package contents, secrets, history bodies, or diagnostics are retained.
